original.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema of buckets.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, the Bucket field status.artifact.digest is newly required, and Bucket objects that omit it are rejected.

decision.reason: The diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] shows that `status.artifact.digest` is required in the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 Bucket schema. It was in the schema before but not required. Two deterministic validators checked this against those artifacts and confirmed both the subject and the now-required change. The change applies only to the v1beta2 schema, so setting version=v1beta2 in the subject is correct.
